symbols.name: output coordinate count
symbols.meaning: The number of coordinates of each output vector of the linear map $T$.
symbols.quote: Let $T\colon \mathbb{C}^m \to \mathbb{C}^{m'}$ be a linear map, where $m$ is the number of coordinates of its input vectors and $m'$ is the number of coordinates of its output vectors.

symbols.name: carried error
symbols.meaning: The error that a computation carries in place of the exact input $x$, a vector in $\mathbb{C}^m$.
symbols.quote: A computation holds $x+\xi$ in place of the exact input $x$, where $\xi$ is the carried error.

symbols.name: rounding error
symbols.meaning: The error that a single step introduces by rounding, a vector in $\mathbb{C}^{m'}$.
symbols.quote: A step computes $T(x+\xi)+\zeta$, where $\zeta$ is the rounding error that the step introduces.

symbols.name: operator norm
symbols.meaning: The largest value of $\|Tx\|$ over all vectors $x$ with $\|x\| \le 1$.
symbols.quote: Its operator norm $\|T\|$ is defined through the [Supremum](supremum.md) of $\|Tx\|$ over all $x$ with $\|x\| \le 1$

relations.quote: A linear contraction is a linear map defined on the vector spaces of [Linear algebra basics](linear-algebra-basics.md) that never increases the largest coordinate modulus of a vector.
Its operator norm $\|T\|$ is defined through the [Supremum](supremum.md) of $\|Tx\|$ over all $x$ with $\|x\| \le 1$.
